generation_parents.algorithm: Sort all feasible customers by the base score d_cur - 0.6*d_dep, then among a scale-free near-tie window defined by the span of base scores, refine by a composite priority that rewards tight capacity fit (small slack) while penalizing distance back to the depot, so the next stop balances route-closing cost against packing the vehicle fuller.
